scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:web: npx --yes wait-on http://127.0.0.1:9001/api/health -t 120000 && npm run dev --workspace=apps/web
scripts.check:web: npm run format:check --workspace=apps/web && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.check:backend: npm run build --workspace=apps/backend-nest && npm run test:pagination --workspace=apps/backend-nest
